## Personality

Coyle exhibits a mischievous demeanor in his interactions with others. He demonstrates this by secretly drawing caricatures of girls with animal heads on his slate and showing them to those around him.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P41](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0041)_

## History

Dan Coyle insulted [Grace](../character/grace.md) while she walked through the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) alongside [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md). The following Monday, Coyle taunted both [Grace](../character/grace.md) and Mrs. [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), leading Edmund to defend the women and challenge Coyle to a fight. On Tuesday evening at the school, Coyle fought Edmund, who fiercely defeated him and forced him to retract his insults.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P0](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P22](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0022), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P27](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0027), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P50](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0050), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P3](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P11](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0011), +6 more_

## Relationships

### [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/coyle--edmund-carrow.md)

Coyle became an adversary of [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md) after publicly taunting [Grace](../character/grace.md) and Mrs. [Carrow](../character/carrow.md). Defensive of the women, Edmund challenged Coyle to a fight at school the following evening. Coyle fought him fiercely, but Edmund ultimately forced Coyle to retract his insults.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P20](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0020), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P3](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P11](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0011), +8 more_
